string-array.name: community_submission_rules
string-array.item: Only submit apps that are genuinely FOSS (Free and Open Source Software) with a verifiable source repository.
Do not submit duplicate entries — search first to check if the app already exists.
Provide accurate package names. Incorrect package names will be rejected.
Include a valid license (e.g. GPL-3.0, MIT, Apache-2.0). Submissions without a license will be rejected.
Do not submit proprietary, freemium, or source-available apps as FOSS alternatives.
Submissions must be relevant alternatives to the proprietary app listed.
